reason: A DSH plugin collection primarily focused on integrating DSH conversations with WeChat, with additional image-analysis and wallpaper features.

summaries.zh: 一组面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，将对话桥接到微信，并提供图片识别与网页壁纸功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin collection that bridges conversations with WeChat and adds image analysis and web wallpaper features.

capabilities: Bridges DSH conversations with WeChat messages and replies
Calls the SiliconFlow vision API using a configured credential or API key
Runs and supervises a local WeChat bridge subprocess
Provides an authenticated localhost HTTP endpoint for sending messages or files
Reads and stores user-selected image files for wallpaper and vision features
Stores and uses WeChat login data and plugin configuration
